name: Fairmont Austin
positioning: A 37-story downtown Austin hotel with a rooftop pool, a spa and a Fairmont Gold level
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown Austin base with a rooftop pool and spa
Guests who want a private lounge level with Fairmont Gold

facts.text: The hotel is a 37-story tower that stands out on the Austin skyline.
The rooftop pool area has cabanas and a rooftop bar serving cocktails and bites.
Fairmont Spa Austin has nine treatment rooms, including two couples suites.
The fitness center is on the 6th floor.
Fairmont Gold includes complimentary breakfast and afternoon canapes.
Fulton is the hotel's lobby restaurant.
Dining features farm-to-table ingredients, ranch-raised beef and craft cocktails.
The Presidential Suite has top-floor views, separate living and dining areas and a private fitness space.
The hotel welcomes pets weighing up to 25 pounds for a one-time fee of $100.

highlights.text: The hotel has Austin's largest rooftop pool.
The hotel has direct access to The Confluence at Waterloo Greenway, where scenic trails, public art and green space begin just steps from the hotel.
The spa has two solariums with panoramic skyline views; each has a saline soaking pool, eucalyptus steam grotto and European dry heat sauna.
Fairmont Gold rooms are on the 32nd through 35th floors, with private check-in and a private lounge with a private concierge.

considerations.text: Parking is available for an additional fee.
The hotel is approximately 10 miles from Austin Bergstrom International Airport.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning and downtown location.
